steps.after:
<!--- A verified Business support session takes precedence over legacy cookies.
              This is DEV-only; production identity and all normal login flows are unchanged. --->
        <cfif getCurrentEnvironment() EQ "dev"
            AND structKeyExists(SESSION, "devAuth") AND isStruct(SESSION.devAuth)
            AND structKeyExists(SESSION.devAuth, "origin") AND SESSION.devAuth.origin EQ "business">
            <cfif structKeyExists(SESSION.devAuth, "isImpersonating") AND SESSION.devAuth.isImpersonating
                AND structKeyExists(SESSION.devAuth, "impersonatedUsuarioId")>
                <cfset cookieId = SESSION.devAuth.impersonatedUsuarioId & "" />
            <cfelseif structKeyExists(SESSION.devAuth, "isImpersonating") AND NOT SESSION.devAuth.isImpersonating
                AND structKeyExists(SESSION.devAuth, "originalUsuarioId")>
                <cfset cookieId = SESSION.devAuth.originalUsuarioId & "" />
            <cfelse>
                <cfreturn usuario />
            </cfif>
        <cfelse>
            <cfif NOT structKeyExists(COOKIE, "id") OR NOT len(trim(COOKIE.id))>
                <cfreturn usuario />
            </cfif>
            <cfset cookieId = trim(COOKIE.id) />
        </cfif>
